title: Microsoft Edge: top sites in the Edge search bar
summary: The roadmap facts and both documented Edge policy controls are supported. The registry paths are valid despite the automatic pre-check warnings, and the changed policy index does not invalidate the briefing. Searches found no published default or feature-specific licensing requirement.
